product_metadata.title: Art3d Reversible Non-Slip Anti-Fatigue Comfort Mat, Cushion Comfort Chef Mat, All-Purpose Comfort - for Kitchen, Bathroom or Workstations, Ergonomically Engineered, Non-Toxic, Waterproof, 18" x 30"
features: ✅ Anti Fatigue Floor Mat: The Art3d anti-fatigue mat enhances comfort while standing. It is professionally engineered and can be used as padded kitchen mat or for your standup desk that is guaranteed not to lose support over time.

✅ Comfort and Quality: It's made of high-quality, soft PVC foam which provides a thick cushion to provide support and comfort when standing. Relieves pressure on muscles and joints, and alleviates foot, knee, leg and back discomfort. High-quality material is durable and long-lasting.
✅ Easy to clean: The surface material of the kitchen mats is made to deter dust and debris and the waterproof material is easy to clean. Simply wipe with a wet cloth, vacuum or sweep to keep clean.

✅ Multi-use Floor Mat: The Art3d standing pad is exceptional for your office while standing at your desk, the kitchen while doing dishes, the laundry room while folding clothes and while working at your workbench.

👍 Lifetime Satisfaction: Art3d is trusted by hundreds of thousands happy customers around the world. Your complete satisfaction is our top priority. If you’re not 100% satisfied, we offer a Lifetime Money Back or Replacement Guarantee with no questions asked.
description: Standing while you work has never been so comfortable. Enjoy the exceptional blend of decorative style and memory foam comfort with Art3d kitchen chef mats enhanced with Bounce Comfort technology. Standing for long periods of time can takes its toll on your back and feet and affect your overall health. Place an anti-fatigue comfort mat where you stand most and enjoy continuous relief while you work. Our Stone & Wood design is perfect for any kitchen or work space. Each mat is light-weight for easy moving and cleaning, with a non-slip textured surface and non-skid bottom for safety. Durable dense memory foam construction provides stain and tear resistance for years of use. Comfort mats make great gifts for the holidays or just to let someone know you care.
The Art3d doormat offers exceptional value, and is ideal for mudroom, garage entry or both sides of the entry door. It absorbs liquid and traps debris keeping your floors clean and dry.

The Art3d door mat will be a welcome addition to your home when inclement weather strikes. Textures door mat offers exceptional value, and is ideal for mudroom, garage entry or both sides of the entry door. Made from recycled rubber and plastic bottles.
The Art3d doormat is designed with anti-slip material on back, which has strong anti-slip function, protect floor and keep still.
Functional and attractive surface patterns enhance scrapping properties

The absorbent carpet surface is extra durable due to a rubber reinforced backing. The patterns enhance the capability of this mat to remove mud and other particles from your shoes. Art3d door mat is made with a water absorbent fiber surface that scrapes shoes clean and can enhance the life of your floors.
